ariy relays incoming SMS from this phone to your ippu device over end-to-end encrypted FCM, and can send SMS from this SIM on command from ippu. It can also forward each SMS to a webhook.

v1.18 — Haptic feedback: switches, tab/back navigation, and pairing scans now give a gentle tap or confirm/error buzz (respecting your system "Touch feedback" setting).

v1.17 — Internal: replaced a deprecated telephony API used to label which SIM a synced message arrived on.

v1.16 — Performance: the relay's duplicate index is kept in memory and the inbox repush batches its progress writes — fewer disk writes and decrypts on the relay path.

v1.15 — Status, About and the bottom tabs now match ippu's design: card sections with icon headers, a hero About with changelog and Help, and labels that appear only on the selected tab.

v1.14 — n8n no longer gets duplicate posts: each relay destination dedups per message, so the missed-SMS sync stops re-sending what the live relay already delivered.

v1.13 — The Pairing screen now matches ippu's — same layout, order and wording. Generating the shared key lives on ippu, where it belongs.

v1.12 — "Repush entire inbox to ippu" (Status) re-sends every SMS so ippu can rebuild its history after a gap; ippu drops duplicates by content hash.

v1.11 — Relayed messages carry the SMS's real time, so a delayed or synced message lands in the right place in ippu's conversation.

v1.10 — Keep-alive service, battery-optimization exemption, and a missed-SMS sync to catch messages received while the app was asleep. New Diagnostics screen makes failures visible.

v1.9 — Large collapsing header on every tab: the title starts big and shrinks into the toolbar as you scroll.

v1.8 — Appearance settings (theme mode, colour, pure-black AMOLED) and a bottom-tab interface.

v1.7 — Material 3 Expressive visual refresh.

v1.6 — Fixed: SEND_SMS could never be granted, which broke sending on command from ippu.

v1.5 — Reverse pairing by QR: ariy shows a QR of its own token for ippu to scan.

v1.4 — Renamed to ariy, with new wordmark icons.

v1.3 — Bidirectional relay: ippu can compose a message that this phone sends from its SIM.

v1.2 — Groundwork for ippu's chat history; icon and keyboard fixes.

v1.1 — SIM names and which SIM a message arrived on; delivery-priority fix; wordmark icon.

v1.0 — Initial release: relay incoming SMS to ippu over end-to-end encrypted FCM, and to an n8n webhook.

On the Status screen, grant SMS access and exempt the app from battery optimization. Without SMS access nothing is relayed; without the battery exemption the system may sleep the app and miss messages.

Open Settings → Pairing. Scan ippu\'s code to fill in ippu\'s device token and the shared key in one step, or paste them by hand. The shared key is generated on ippu — ariy only receives it, so both ends always match.

To let ippu compose messages this phone sends from its SIM: import the FCM service-account key, turn on \"Send SMS on command from ippu\", and grant SEND_SMS. The first time you send to a short code, Android may ask you to allow it — choose \"Always allow\".
Optionally forward every SMS to a webhook as well. In Settings → Webhook, enable it and enter the URL and auth header. Each message is sent once; duplicates from the missed-SMS sync are suppressed.

\"Sync missed SMS now\" (Status) catches messages that arrived while the app was asleep. \"Repush entire inbox to ippu\" re-sends every SMS so ippu can rebuild its history after a gap — ippu ignores anything it already has.

Settings → Diagnostics logs each relay with the reason when it fails. If ippu isn\'t receiving: check the shared key matches and ippu\'s token is current (re-scan if ippu was reinstalled), and keep this app battery-unrestricted.
Name each SIM so relayed messages show the carrier (e.g. \"+9715… on e&\") without needing phone-state access. Leave blank to use \"SIM 1\" / \"SIM 2\".
Pair this phone with the ippu app so SMS relay there, encrypted end-to-end. Scan ippu\'s code to exchange device tokens and the shared key, or enter them by hand.
